entries.text: TSBS DevOps, Data Vault, NYC Taxi, Flight Data, Vector Search, Write Primitives and Metadata Primitives declare `duckdb` as their source dialect and route their SQL through `translate_sql_query` for every target platform, instead of handing engines raw DuckDB-flavoured text (TSBS and Data Vault translated only for cloud dialects, NYC Taxi and Flight Data for a few, Write and Metadata Primitives never). NULL ordering and other dialect semantics now follow the translation rules on every platform. Hand-written per-platform variants stay verbatim and are recorded with the reason translation cannot express them in the translation-bypass allowlist test, which pins that no benchmark reaches an engine without translation otherwise. Read Primitives keeps its Netezza source dialect. The generated query docs for these benchmarks show the translated, pretty-printed DataFusion SQL instead of the authored text.

The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.16 to 30.24.0.17. Spark and Databricks now write `DATE_TRUNC('DAY', x)` instead of `TRUNC(x, 'DAY')`, which returned NULL. QuestDB lowers the EXISTS, NOT EXISTS and IN subqueries of TPC-DS Q16, Q94 and Q95 (and the same shapes in TPC-DS Q14, Q23, Q33, Q56, Q58, Q60, Q70, Q83, TPC-H Q18, Q20 and Q21) to joins. SQLite no longer emits NULLS FIRST or NULLS LAST inside CREATE INDEX key lists, which SQLite rejects.
